title: Criteria for selection of trenchless technology
markdown:
| No. | Diameter of Pipe | Suitable Trenchless Technology |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | < 1,000 mm | Guided Boring |
| 2 | 1,000 mm – 1,500 mm | Pipe Jacking |
| 3 | > 1,500 mm | Tunnel Boring |

transcription.method: direct visual reading of rendered source page; no OCR
transcription.observations: Read each cell or formula and its printed context directly.

visual_recheck.method: distinct second direct visual comparison; same assistant, not independent human review
visual_recheck.observations: Rechecked every cell of 3 rows, headers/units and all printed notes in the separate source-region pass.
